# Niddesavāra (Ne 3)

**Section:** Netti (ne)

**Title (Pali):** Niddesavāra

## AI-generated Overview (from reference literature)

*This overview was drafted by an AI model from the cited scholarship and catalog data and may contain errors; verify against the sources before relying on it.*

The *Niddesavāra* ("Demonstrative Subsection", Nett 3,8–5,7) is a structural subsection of the *Nettippakaraṇa*, following the *Uddesavāra* [von Hinüber 1996]. It sets out the sixteen *hāras* ("modes of conveying") and the five *nayas* ("guide-lines"), followed by an enumeration of twelve *padas* ("terms"), of which six relate to linguistic form (*vyañjana*) and six to meaning (*attha*) [von Hinüber 1996]. This group of twelve terms constitutes a *sutta* comprising the entire utterance of the Buddha [von Hinüber 1996]. The closing verses of the *Niddesavāra* synthesize these categories, showing how the *nayas* and *padas* correlate with meaning (*attha*) and form [von Hinüber 1996]. The verses presented in the *Niddesavāra* serve as a foundational template for the subsequent *Paṭiniddesa* (specifically the *Hāravibhaṅga*), which quotes each respective verse and illustrates it using textual examples drawn from the Suttapiṭaka [von Hinüber 1996].
